description: Open a new review room on a page you built — a preview deploy, a staging URL — and get back the link to hand to a human. Call this when you have something for someone to look at, rather than asking them to open a URL and describe what they see. The page is framed live and reviewers annotate it directly; their feedback then reaches you through the other tools. Pass `repo` + `branch` (and `sha`) when the page comes from a branch: a later preview of the same repo and branch becomes the next version of this one, and reviewers can step between versions. Over stdio this also connects you to the new room. Over HTTP the endpoint stays bound to the room in its URL, so reconnect to the returned `mcpUrl` to work the new room.

branch.description: Branch the preview was built from.

note.description: What changed and what to look at, for the reviewers.

previous.description: The room this is a new version of, as a link or id. Defaults to the room you are connected to. Linked only when that room has the same repo and branch.

questions.description: Polls to open the room with — a decision you want the reviewers to make.

sha.description: Commit the preview was built from; shown beside the version.

title.description: What this is, in a few words — shown to reviewers.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to review.

name: marklayer_share_preview
